question: With which of the following sports is Sebastian Korda associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sebastian Korda**__

 
 
• He is an **American professional tennis player.**
 
• He has won one **ATP singles tournament, the 2021 Emilia-Romagna Open.**
 
• He also won the **junior title at the 2018 Australian Open.**
